snippet.title: RindTown Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the juice master of an anime town. 🍹

RindTown is a Balatro-like where every customer walks up to your window with an order, and you answer it with a drink built from cards. Pick your five, blend them, and watch the numbers explode.

Thirty days. One rising target. Customers who break the rules. How far can your juice stall go?

🎮 FREE DEMO: October 15, 2026
🎪 Steam Next Fest: October 19, 2026

If you liked Balatro, here is what is different:
• Every customer asks for something different, and the right drink pays off
• The order of the cards in your glass matters
• Machines and tools turn a small stall into a huge engine
• Special Guests with rules of their own

Made by Sehr Games, a two-person indie team.

#RindTown #Balatrolike #Deckbuilder #Roguelike #indiegame #SteamNextFest
